summary: Comprehensive testing of Knowledge Graph Prep feature. All 19 backend API tests passed. Frontend Knowledge Graph page loads correctly with stats bar (113 actors, 21 locations, 144 edges, 43 cross-border actors, 5 border zones), actor cards, location cards, actor detail view, and all filters working.
passed_tests: GET /api/knowledge-graph/stats - returns 200 with built:true, 113 actors, 21 locations, 144 edges
GET /api/knowledge-graph/stats - has all expected fields (actors, locations, edges, cross_border_actors, border_locations, top_actors, top_locations)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors - returns 200 with list of actors
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors - actors have expected fields (name, activity_count, locations, threat_types, is_cross_border)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors?cross_border=true - returns only cross-border actors (43 actors)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors?limit=10 - respects limit parameter
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors/Assam%20Police - returns actor detail with edges
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors/ULFA(I) - handles special characters (regex escape test)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/actors/NonExistentActor - returns 404 for non-existent actor
GET /api/knowledge-graph/locations - returns 200 with list of locations (21 locations)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/locations - locations have expected fields (name, activity_count, actors, is_border)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/locations?is_border=true - returns only border locations (5 locations)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/edges - returns 200 with list of edges (144 edges)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/edges - edges have expected fields (actor, location, count, contexts)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/edges?min_count=2 - filters by minimum count
GET /api/knowledge-graph/network - returns 200 with nodes and links for visualization
GET /api/knowledge-graph/network - nodes have expected fields (id, label, type)
GET /api/knowledge-graph/network - links have expected fields (source, target, weight)
POST /api/knowledge-graph/build - returns 200 with 'Knowledge graph build started' message
Frontend Knowledge Graph page loads at /knowledge-graph
Frontend stats bar shows 113 actors, 21 locations, 144 edges, 43 cross-border, 5 border zones
Frontend Actors tab shows 100 actor cards with severity badges, locations, threat types
Frontend Locations tab shows 21 location cards with actors and activity counts
Frontend actor detail view shows locations, threats, co-occurring actors, movement edges, related articles
Frontend cross-border filter correctly filters to 43 actors
Frontend border zones filter correctly filters to 5 locations
Frontend search functionality works correctly
Navigation sidebar shows Knowledge Graph link
critical_code_review_comments: Knowledge graph builder correctly normalizes actor names (e.g., 'Border Security Force' -> 'BSF', 'ULFA (I)' -> 'ULFA(I)')
Regex escape fix in actor detail endpoint correctly handles special characters like parentheses in ULFA(I)
Frontend correctly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
Stats bar correctly displays all KG metrics from the API
Actor detail view shows comprehensive information including movement edges and related articles
test_credentials: No credentials needed - app has no auth system
seed_data_creation: None - used existing knowledge graph data (113 actors, 21 locations, 144 edges built from intelligence items)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Knowledge Graph feature fully tested and working.
